fact: Algeria launched its first national AI and cybersecurity start-up cluster on 18 April 2026 at the Sidi Abdellah science and technology hub in Algiers, backed by the Higher Education, Knowledge Economy and Telecommunications ministries; no cohort is named.
El Watan says the network of Maisons de l'IA serves as hubs for awareness and socio-economic partnership, with no incubation programme stated.
